subject.title: [MiniMax] M3 native video input support with timestamp-scaling metadata hint (reference branch only)

question: Should MiniMax M3 native video be pursued as a provider-owned media-understanding feature, as part of the broader direct-video chat input contract, or deferred until the generic video-upload decision is settled?
rationale: Current source proves the capability is missing, but implementing it would set provider API, raw-media egress, prompt/session, and tool-result content contracts that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Split MiniMax Work After Core Policy
options.body: Define the raw-video/security and content-contract policy first, then accept narrow MiniMax provider patches for video transport and timestamp metadata.

options.title: Track Under Generic Video Upload
options.body: Fold the MiniMax details into the broader direct-video tracker and close this later only after the provider-specific timestamp behavior is preserved there.

options.title: Defer Native MiniMax Video
options.body: Keep current image-only MiniMax behavior and document direct media-understanding or external preprocessing as the supported path for now.

recommendation.title: Split MiniMax Work After Core Policy
recommendation.body: Define the raw-video/security and content-contract policy first, then accept narrow MiniMax provider patches for video transport and timestamp metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal for MiniMax M3 support and media/plugin boundary refactors touched by this decision.
